item.title: Airbnbs? DeLand isn’t ready to decide
item.description: DeLand is going to have to wait a bit to find out whether short-term rentals (STRs) will be able to operate legally in the city. City commissioners say they need more information before deciding whether — and how — to change DeLand’s law to allow them. item.title: From slaughterhouse to studio: Lake Helen artist finds beauty and possibility in old Florida
item.description: The old slaughterhouse sits at the edge of an open field, its rough boards and wide doors rooted in Florida’s agricultural past. On a bright morning, the scene feels transformed. item.title: DeLand will welcome hundreds of bikers tomorrow
item.description: Motorcyclists from all over the country will roar into Downtown DeLand tomorrow, Feb. 28, for the annual all-day party known as the DeLand Bike Rally.
